aliased wrappers.

three currency/presence lines.

team scope) vs unresolved (no matching identity) (ethos-jw1z), and add a
doctor check for archetype files missing require_delegated_worker,
naming which layer is stale (ethos-e05k).

Mission: m-2026-09-10-001
EOF
)"
